title: Bình minh trên hồ
intendedUse: Decorative background artwork produced during development.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: decorative landscape image for a Vietnamese emotional wellbeing web app.
Style and medium: restrained dreamy painterly realism, a very subtle matte painted finish over believable natural textures, atmospheric depth, premium editorial landscape artwork.
Lighting and palette: misty lavender dawn, soft blush sky, pale blue distance, muted violet shadows, restrained natural green, gentle diffuse light, soft contrast and delicate color transitions. Natural and serene, neither oversaturated nor grey and muddy.
Composition and framing: wide 16:9 landscape, one complete edge-to-edge scene, three clear layers of foreground, middle distance and far distance. Keep the scenic identity in the central third so a tall mobile center crop still feels complete. Place intricate details near the outer lower edges; keep the central area and upper sky quiet enough to sit behind app controls. No large hard black silhouettes.
Constraints: landscape artwork only, no interface or frame, no text, no lettering, no typography, no people, no faces, no animals, no buildings, no boats, no roads, no poles, no logos, no watermark. This is invented decorative scenery inspired by Vietnam, not a claim to document a real place.
Primary request: a still freshwater lake inspired by northern Vietnam at lavender dawn.
Scene: a wide glassy lake reflecting a pale pink and blue sky; softly rounded limestone karst hills surround the distant shore, with a low bank of translucent silver mist resting on the water. A few soft grasses and small smooth stones touch the lower outer corners. The main rounded mountain sits behind the central open reflective water, smaller distant ridges fading in luminous mist. A delicate blush glow is reflected across the lake. Calm expansive space, fine natural shoreline texture and believable reflections.
